rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for a fighter in boxing.

example.english: The boxer in this match is really good.
example.traditional: 呢場拳賽嗰個拳手打得好勁。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 kyun4 coi3 go2 go3 kyun4 sau2 daa2 dak1 hou2 ging6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the Boxer breed of dog.

example.english: My friend keeps a boxer at home.
example.traditional: 我朋友屋企養咗隻拳師狗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 joeng5 zo2 zek3 kyun4 si1 gau2
